messages.subject: Five-a-side tonight?
messages.plaintextBody:
Elena - are you in for five-a-side tonight at 7? We're one short and Marcus dropped out. Pitch booked at the Bishopsgate centre. Let me know ASAP.

Tom

(Sorry - meant to send this to the other Elena in litigation, but you're welcome to play if you fancy it!)
